SELECT a.Airline
FROM airlines AS a
LEFT JOIN flights AS f ON f.Airline = a.uid
GROUP BY a.uid, a.Airline
HAVING COUNT(f.Airline) < 200;
--

WITH first_three AS (
  SELECT a.uid, a.Airline
  FROM airlines AS a
  LEFT JOIN flights AS f ON f.Airline = a.uid
  GROUP BY a.uid, a.Airline
  HAVING COUNT(f.FlightNo) < 200
  ORDER BY a.uid
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT ft.Airline, ap.Country
FROM first_three AS ft
JOIN flights AS f ON f.Airline = ft.uid
JOIN airports AS ap ON ap.AirportCode = f.DestAirport
ORDER BY ft.Airline, ap.Country;
